main.title: Samsung labor negotiations collapse; strike looms
main.body:
The labor union and management at Samsung Electronics failed to narrow their differences over performance-based bonuses on the second and final day of government-led mediation talks that ended early Wednesday, raising concerns that the union may go ahead with a general strike later this month.

The talks, seen as a last-ditch effort to avert the general strike, began at 10 a.m. Tuesday at the National Labor Relations Commission office in the administrative city of Sejong, but both sides failed to reach a consensus despite nearly 17 hours of negotiations.

Choi Seung-ho, head of Samsung Electronics' largest labor union, stated after the meeting: 'Because the differences between the labor union and management did not narrow, we requested mediation and waited for nearly 12 hours but the proposal only worsened.' He indicated the union declared the mediation talks have fallen through.

Samsung's labor union is demanding performance-based bonuses equivalent to 15 percent of operating profit, along with the removal of the payout cap and the formal institutionalization of the bonus system. The union earlier announced plans to stage a general strike starting May 21 if its demands are not met.

Choi stated that approximately 41,000 unionized workers have expressed their intention to participate in the general strike, with potential numbers exceeding 50,000.

The labor dispute at Samsung Electronics, the world's largest memory chip maker and South Korea's most valuable company, has raised concerns that a walkout could disrupt production and affect the semiconductor supply chain and broader economy.

main.title: OpenAI, Microsoft And Friends Build A Better, More Scalable Ethernet
main.body:
A consortium of major technology companies has developed Multipath Reliable Connection (MRC), a new networking protocol designed to improve scalability for AI cluster infrastructure. The collaboration involves OpenAI, Microsoft, Broadcom, AMD, and Nvidia, with the goal of creating more efficient alternatives to traditional high-bandwidth networking approaches.

The MRC protocol represents an evolution of existing RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE) technology. Rather than pursuing ever-higher port bandwidth, the new approach distributes aggregate switch bandwidth across more numerous, lower-bandwidth connections. This strategy increases network radix—the number of links between devices—while reducing latency and costs.

According to the technical approach, the protocol achieves 'essentially no congestion in the core of the network' through adaptive packet spraying load-balancing. The system supports eight independent Clos topology data planes, providing multiple paths between any two endpoints.

The architecture enables significant scaling improvements. A two-tier MRC network can connect 131,072 compute engines with only three hops maximum between any two devices, compared to traditional three-tier networks supporting 65,536 GPUs with up to seven hops. This improvement requires only 20% more switches for double the compute capacity.

The MRC protocol has been tested at Oracle's Stargate datacenter in Abilene, Texas and Microsoft's Azure AI facility in Fairwater, Wisconsin. Implementation includes Nvidia ConnectX-8 SmartNICs, AMD DPUs, and Broadcom Thor Ultra SmartNICs, with routing implemented on Nvidia Spectrum switches and Arista Networks infrastructure.

main.title: Cerebras' $48 Billion IPO Tests the Market's Inference Bet
main.body:
Cerebras Systems' initial public offering was priced at $150-$160 per share on May 13, 2026, with the company set to begin Nasdaq trading on May 14 under ticker CBRS. The company raised approximately $4.8 billion with a fully diluted valuation reaching $48.8 billion.

The pricing represented a significant upward revision from the original range of $115-$125, with demand exceeding 20 times the available shares. The company's WSE-3 (Wafer Scale Engine 3) architecture targets AI inference workloads, positioning it as an alternative to GPU-based solutions.

OpenAI committed to a 750-megawatt deal valued at over $20 billion, while AWS announced deployment plans for Cerebras systems in Amazon data centers. The company achieved $510 million in 2025 revenue (up 76% year-over-year) with a 47% net margin, though GAAP operating losses remained.

The analysis identifies three structural risks: heavy customer concentration around OpenAI, dependence on TSMC for manufacturing with no long-term supply commitments, and potential competitive pressure from Nvidia's continued R&D investments and recent acquisitions.

The valuation reflects an approximately 51x trailing revenue multiple, pricing in sustained growth execution and expanded margins as cloud services revenue increases.

main.title: MinIO adds petabyte-scale MemKV cache for Nvidia GPU inference
main.body:
MinIO has developed a petabyte-scale MemKV caching system designed to work with Nvidia GPUs, built on top of its AIStor object storage platform.

The system addresses a critical challenge in GPU inference operations. When GPUs running AI workloads exhaust their high-bandwidth memory (HBM), data flows downstream through a memory hierarchy—CPU DRAM, then NVMe SSDs with controller software on Nvidia's BlueField-4 DPUs, and finally to backing object storage like MinIO's AIStor. MemKV aligns with Nvidia's STX architecture to enable persistent, shared context across GPU clusters at unprecedented scale.

In a 128-GPU deployment with 128K-token context, the system increased GPU utilization from 50 percent to over 90 percent, reportedly yielding $2 million in annual compute savings.

Key technical features include native BlueField-4 STX support running as ARM64-native binary embedded in storage infrastructure, end-to-end RDMA transport moving KV cache data directly from GPU memory to NVMe without file system or object storage protocol overhead, GPU-optimized block sizes operating in 2-16 MB blocks rather than legacy 4 KB blocks, and wire-speed fabric performance built for Nvidia Spectrum-X Ethernet and PCIe Gen6.

MemKV moves data directly from NVMe SSDs to the AI data path via RDMA, eliminating HTTP overhead, file system translation, and intermediate storage servers between GPUs and context storage. Other suppliers offering STX-compatible KV cache solutions include GRAID and WEKA.

main.select_reason: BlueField-4 DPU STX 네이티브 + RDMA로 GPU↔NVMe 직접 전송, 128 GPU에서 활용률 50→90% 실증 — DPU 기반 인퍼런스 메모리 계층의 양산형 사례로 MangoBoost 직접 인접 영역.

main.title: 리벨리온, 국민성장펀드 6000억 수령 완료...차세대 AI칩 양산 본격화
main.body:
리벨리온이 국민성장펀드로부터 6,000억 원 투자금 납입을 완료하며 차세대 AI 칩 양산을 본격화한다고 발표했다. 이번 투자는 기금운용심의회 직접 투자 2,500억 원, 산업은행 500억 원, 미래에셋을 비롯한 민간 3,000억 원으로 구성됐다.

리벨리온은 이 자금을 활용해 차세대 칩 '리벨 100' 양산에 집중하고, 미국 등 글로벌 시장 진출을 추진한다. 잠재 고객사로는 메타(Meta)와 xAI가 언급됐다. 양산은 삼성 파운드리를 통해 진행되며, 이전 아톰(Atom) NPU 출하량 수준의 물량을 목표로 한다.

지난해 리벨리온의 연결 기준 매출은 320억 원으로 전년 대비 3배 성장했으며, SK텔레콤의 AI 서비스에 아톰 칩 채택이 성장을 견인했다.

6,400억 원 규모의 프리IPO 투자 유치 성공으로 하반기 기업공개(IPO) 가능성이 높아졌으며, 삼성증권과 한국투자증권이 주관사로 선정됐다. 리벨리온의 현재 기업가치는 3조 4,000억 원이며, 이르면 8월 거래소 상장 예비 심사 청구가 예상된다.

main.title: BofA hikes 2026 chips forecast to $1.3 trillion, names Nvidia, Broadcom, Marvell, AMD as top drivers
main.body:
Bank of America analyst Vivek Arya significantly increased the firm's global semiconductor revenue outlook, raising the 2026 target to $1.3 trillion—a $300 billion jump from estimates provided four months earlier. The upgrade reflects accelerating momentum in the AI sector.

Arya stated that 'AI/data center to drive the majority of gains (via compute, networking, memory), with industrial contributing to growths on inventory replenishment and robotics ramp.' The semiconductor market is projected to reach $2 trillion by 2030, representing a 20% compound annual growth rate—more than double the historical 9% average.

BofA identified Nvidia and Broadcom as primary drivers of growth, while also recommending Marvell Technology and Advanced Micro Devices as 'AI compute' leaders. Equipment manufacturers Applied Materials and Lam Research are positioned as beneficiaries of increased chip production demands.

The bank flagged software firms Cadence and Synopsys as 'picks and shovels' plays, serving the design phase of the AI expansion. BofA's analysis suggests chip vendors require global cloud capital expenditure exceeding $1 trillion by 2027—substantially above current consensus forecasts of $872 billion—raising questions about whether hyperscaler investments will deliver promised returns.
main.source: Yahoo Finance / Bank of America Research
main.keep_reason: BofA가 2026 글로벌 반도체 시장 $1.3T 상향, Marvell·NVIDIA·Broadcom·AMD를 AI 컴퓨트 리더로 지목 — MangoBoost 시장 환경 핵심 지표.
main.select_reason: BofA 2026 반도체 매출 전망 $1.3T로 $300B 상향, AMD·Marvell·NVIDIA·Broadcom을 AI 컴퓨트 리더로 명시 — MangoBoost가 위치한 시장 규모 지표의 권위 있는 상향.

main.title: Samsung Electronics, 4분기 '포스트 HBM' CXL 3.1 양산 추진
main.body:
삼성전자가 2026년 4분기 CXL(Compute Express Link) 3.1 기반 메모리 모듈 양산을 추진한다. 회사는 3분기부터 주요 서버 및 데이터센터 기업에 CMM-D(CXL 메모리 모듈) 3.1 샘플을 공급하기 시작할 예정이다.

CXL 3.1 CMM-D 샘플은 마이크로소프트, 구글, 아마존, 메타, 델, 슈퍼마이크로 등 전 세계 약 40개 고객사에 공급될 예정이다. 고객사 품질 테스트는 4분기에 진행돼 양산 계획으로 이어질 것으로 예상된다.

CMM-D 3.1은 PCIe 6.0 인터페이스를 사용하며 최대 1TB 용량과 72GB/초 대역폭을 지원한다. 이전 세대 CMM-D 2.0은 최대 256GB 용량과 36GB/초 대역폭을 제공했다.

시장조사업체 욜(Yole)에 따르면 CXL 시장은 AI 데이터센터 수요에 힘입어 2025년 21억 달러(약 2조 8,700억 원)에서 2028년 160억 달러(약 21조 8,400억 원)로 성장할 것으로 예상된다.

삼성은 당초 2025년 4분기 CXL 3.1 제품을 출시할 계획이었으나 표준 D램과 HBM 솔루션에 대한 시장 수요가 더 강해 출시를 연기했다.
main.keep_reason: 삼성 CXL 3.1 CMM-D Q4 양산 + 글로벌 40개 하이퍼스케일러 샘플 공급 — DPU/메모리 디스애그리게이션과 직결되는 데이터센터 메모리 표준 전환.
main.select_reason: 삼성 CMM-D 3.1 Q4 양산 + 40개 하이퍼스케일러 샘플 공급, PCIe 6.0 / 1TB / 72GB/s — DPU 기반 메모리 디스애그리게이션 표준 전환의 핵심 공급 측 신호.

main.title: Microsoft claims to be first hyperscaler to power on Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 system
main.body:
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella announced that Microsoft was 'the first cloud to bring up an Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 system for validation,' calling it 'another big step in building the next generation of AI infrastructure with Nvidia.' According to a Microsoft blog post, this was done in a Microsoft lab, while the Vera Rubin NVL72 will be rolled out to the company's Azure data centers 'over the next few months.'

The Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 is the flagship datacenter configuration featuring 72 R100 (H300) GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs connected through NVLink 6 interconnects, delivering 260 TB/s all-to-all bandwidth. The system provides up to 5x greater inference performance and 10x lower cost per token than the previous Blackwell generation.

Among the first cloud providers to deploy Vera Rubin-based instances in 2026 will be AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft and OCI, as well as NVIDIA Cloud Partners CoreWeave, Lambda, Nebius and Nscale. Mass production and partner availability is targeted for H2 2026.

Microsoft plans to deploy the Vera Rubin NVL72 rack-scale system in its next-generation AI data centers, including the Fairwater AI superfactory sites. The announcement was made around March 2026 at GTC.
main.keep_reason: MS Azure가 Vera Rubin NVL72 최초 가동 — NVIDIA 차세대 GPU 인프라 배포 개시 및 H2 2026 상용화 일정 확정.
main.select_reason: MS가 Vera Rubin NVL72 최초 가동 — Blackwell 대비 인퍼런스 5배·토큰 비용 1/10, H2 2026 양산 확정으로 차세대 AI 인프라 타임라인이 가시화.

In a 128-GPU deployment with 128K-token context, the system increased GPU utilization from 50 percent to over 90 percent, reportedly yielding $2 million in annual compute savings.

Key technical features include native BlueField-4 STX support running as ARM64-native binary embedded in storage infrastructure, end-to-end RDMA transport moving KV cache data directly from GPU memory to NVMe without file system or object storage protocol overhead, GPU-optimized block sizes operating in 2-16 MB blocks rather than legacy 4 KB blocks, and wire-speed fabric performance built for Nvidia Spectrum-X Ethernet and PCIe Gen6.

MemKV moves data directly from NVMe SSDs to the AI data path via RDMA, eliminating HTTP overhead, file system translation, and intermediate storage servers between GPUs and context storage. Other suppliers offering STX-compatible KV cache solutions include GRAID and WEKA.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: BlueField-4 DPU + RDMA + Spectrum-X 직접 활용한 페타바이트 KV 캐시 — DPU 기반 AI 인퍼런스 메모리 계층의 실증 사례, MangoBoost 핵심 인접 기술.

competitor_articles.title: Microsoft claims to be first hyperscaler to power on Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 system
competitor_articles.body:
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella announced that Microsoft was 'the first cloud to bring up an Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 system for validation,' calling it 'another big step in building the next generation of AI infrastructure with Nvidia.' According to a Microsoft blog post, this was done in a Microsoft lab, while the Vera Rubin NVL72 will be rolled out to the company's Azure data centers 'over the next few months.'

The Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 is the flagship datacenter configuration featuring 72 R100 (H300) GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs connected through NVLink 6 interconnects, delivering 260 TB/s all-to-all bandwidth. The system provides up to 5x greater inference performance and 10x lower cost per token than the previous Blackwell generation.

Among the first cloud providers to deploy Vera Rubin-based instances in 2026 will be AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft and OCI, as well as NVIDIA Cloud Partners CoreWeave, Lambda, Nebius and Nscale. Mass production and partner availability is targeted for H2 2026.

Microsoft plans to deploy the Vera Rubin NVL72 rack-scale system in its next-generation AI data centers, including the Fairwater AI superfactory sites. The announcement was made around March 2026 at GTC.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: MS Azure가 Vera Rubin NVL72 최초 가동 — NVIDIA 차세대 GPU 인프라 배포 개시 및 H2 2026 상용화 일정 확정.

competitor_articles.title: Jensen Huang skips Trump's China business delegation
competitor_articles.body:
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang will not join President Donald Trump's business delegation to China this week, according to Reuters reporting. More than a dozen U.S. executives are traveling with the president, including Apple's Tim Cook and Tesla's Elon Musk, who are scheduled to arrive in Beijing on May 13 for formal state meetings on May 14-15.

The White House has focused the delegation's agenda on agriculture, manufacturing, and commercial aviation—particularly Boeing aircraft orders—rather than AI chip-export disputes that have dominated U.S.-China technology policy for three years.

Huang has been highly visible alongside the Trump administration over the past year, attending multiple events and accompanying the president on overseas trips to the Gulf region. His exclusion from this delegation is being interpreted as deliberate rather than accidental.

The central point of friction remains chip exports. NVIDIA's most advanced GPUs face U.S. export restrictions for Chinese sales. Though the company has developed compliant variants, it continues lobbying for greater integration between national security and commercial interests. Trump and Huang met in March to discuss export limits.

Wall Street analysts suggest Huang's absence reduces the likelihood of meaningful U.S.-China announcements regarding AI chip access during the trip. NVIDIA shares traded modestly higher Monday, with analysts divided on strategic implications.

China remains critical to NVIDIA despite controls, with data-center revenue continuing to grow through regulated H20-class components.

Cook and Musk's inclusion reflects administration preference for major U.S. consumer electronics and EV exposure paired with Chinese manufacturing and consumption. Apple's iPhone supply chain remains heavily China-centered, while Tesla operates its Shanghai gigafactory at significant scale.

Boeing's delegation participation suggests potential commercial aircraft order announcements during the visit.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: NVIDIA CEO의 트럼프 방중 배제 — AI 칩 수출 통제와 미-중 반도체 갈등의 외교적 시그널, NVIDIA 중국 매출에 직접 영향.

competitor_articles.title: FriendliAI Expands to San Francisco to Scale Frontier AI Inference for Open-Weight and Custom Models
competitor_articles.body:
FriendliAI announced the opening of its new San Francisco office at 20 Hawthorne Street, occupying 7,000 square feet in the historic Crown Point Press building, around the corner from the San Francisco Museum of Modern Art.

The expansion places FriendliAI at the heart of the Bay Area AI ecosystem and closer to the customers, partners, and developers building the next generation of AI applications.

AI agents—which plan, reason across many steps, and call tools on every turn—require five to thirty times more tokens per task than chatbots, and that consumption compounds as agents move from pilots into always-on production workflows. FriendliAI is on a trajectory to grow revenue tenfold this year.

Independent benchmarks from Artificial Analysis and OpenRouter rank FriendliAI as the top inference provider for models such as GLM-5.1 and Gemma 4 across output speed, latency, tool calling, and structured outputs.

FriendliAI runs state-of-the-art open-weight and custom models at production scale with industry-leading throughput, latency, and reliability. The company partners with model creators on launch—most recently as a Day 0 partner for NVIDIA Nemotron 3 and Z.ai's GLM-5.1—and with cloud providers including AWS, OCI, and Samsung Cloud Platform.

FriendliAI plans to significantly grow its U.S. team across go-to-market, partnerships, and engineering functions over the coming year. The bright, loft-style space is also purpose-built as a hub for the AI builder community, hosting developer meetups, hackathons, and executive briefings.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: Tier 1 국내 경쟁사 FriendliAI의 SF 사무소 개설 + 매출 10배 성장 궤도 + Artificial Analysis 인퍼런스 1위 — 미국 시장 진입 신호.

competitor_articles.title: FriendliAI may have the inference solution to AI memory ills
competitor_articles.body:
FriendliAI has emerged as a leading inference platform addressing the memory bandwidth bottlenecks that constrain large language model serving. The company's platform uses novel memory management techniques to deliver industry-leading throughput and latency at lower cost than traditional GPU-centric deployments.

As AI agents require five to thirty times more tokens per task than chatbots, inference demand is growing at unprecedented rates. FriendliAI's platform handles this through continuous batching and disaggregated memory management, allowing it to serve multiple concurrent requests efficiently on expensive GPU hardware.

The company ranks first on independent benchmarks from Artificial Analysis and OpenRouter for models including GLM-5.1 and Gemma 4. FriendliAI is on a trajectory to grow revenue tenfold this year, positioning it as one of the fastest-growing inference startups in the space.

The company recently opened a San Francisco office to be closer to Bay Area customers and partners, and has partnerships with AWS, OCI, and Samsung Cloud Platform for infrastructure deployment.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: Tier 1 경쟁사 FriendliAI 인퍼런스 플랫폼의 메모리 관리 차별점 분석 — AI 메모리 병목 해소라는 MangoBoost와 유사 문제 영역.
